about: Bare fetch() calls of /api paths on data a computer holds, each with why it is this computer alone (#12617). A call not here must go through serverFetch with its server. Only ever shorter.

analytics_efficiency.js.reason: the Analytics page is this computer's: every one of its cost and efficiency routes is a bare path, and the page has no computer switch

automation_runs.js.reason: Recent runs (#13183) are this computer's jobs and workflows runs: Automations has no server switch and the route is not on the Hub's allowlist

automations_queue.js.reason: the Queue folder of Automations reads this computer's own resource queue (GET /api/resources); Automations is local-only, as the jobs and workflows its other folders read with bare fetches

board_export.js.reason: the live list is the merged list of every computer ({sessions, servers}); the code below it keeps this board's server

board_fetch.js.reason: this computer's own board list: the remote computers' lists are read next to it with serverFetch

cost_dashboard.js.reason: the Analytics page is this computer's: every one of its cost routes is a bare path, and the page has no computer switch

job_form.js.reason: Automations (scheduled jobs and workflows) run on this computer: the page has no server for them

needs_skills.js.reason: by design, Hub: not enabled (Skills Store stays on the computer in v1)

received_cap_notice.js.reason: this computer's own artifact store notice, never asked through the Hub (isCloud returns first)

resume_dialog.js.reason: Resume launches a new agent on this computer (the dialog has no launch-computer selector); only its source transcript metadata is read from another computer

scheduler.js.reason: Automations (scheduled jobs and workflows) run on this computer: the page has no server for them

team_artifacts_page.js.reason: the Keep list is this computer's own store (/api/system/artifact-store/kept): asked only when local() is true (not through the Hub, not for another computer)

team_form.js.reason: a hint under the folder field (the line stays when the answer is unknown): the server that launches the team decides

team_wizard.js.reason: generating a team runs the CLI on this computer

terminal_backend.js.reason: the auto-wake and hooks banners list this computer's own agents (read from /api/system/auto-wake and /hooks-status)

workflow_agent.js.reason: authoring a workflow launches an agent on this computer

worktrees_panel.js.reason: the worktrees panel lists this computer's folders; removing is not offered through the Hub (canRemove is !isCloud)
